declaration: Flight software for an agricultural spraying drone. We plan spray paths from field maps, test in a PX4 SITL simulator, then fly test fields with a licensed pilot. Spray chemicals and no-fly zones make mistakes expensive. Four of us; firmware updates go to farmers' drones over the air.
answers: A licensed pilot must be present for every real flight and can take over manually. Field maps come as GeoJSON from customers. OTA updates go to a 5% cohort first. Path planning changes are judged by coverage percentage and overspray area in simulation. There is no data we train on.
